title: WEIGHTLESSNESS
author: Dilip Mohapatra
text:
(When the root is lifted, the branches no longer touch the earth)

As you move along
the continuum of ticking time
from the gravid womb
to the grave
gravity takes over
and you are tied down
with multiple weights
through your journey
from the start
when you feel
the weight of your new life
till the end when your body
is the only weight
and your finite self
merges with the infinite
and you finally become
weightless.

You look out of your window
to see the tree
shedding its leaves
which fall in heaps at its root
and its branches reaching for the sun
but then you realise
that you are an
inverted tree
your head being your root
and your limbs
hanging downwards—
and as you ascend
your spine from `muladhar`
to `sahasrar`
along your journey
you transcend
from the gross to the sublime—

you defy gravity
and become weightless
while you are
still breathing.
